Title: Custom Momentum Stock Scanner
I’m looking to develop a custom day trading momentum stock scanner.It revolves around immediate volatility of a stock based on multiples of its previous volatility.I want to use ATR% as the main source of calculations for the scanner.I want to be able to scan stocks based on their recent moves being a multiple of their previous ATR%.ATR% = ATR divided by price, in percentage.example: if a stock’s ATR is 4.01 and the stock price is 50.42, it’s ATR% is 7.95%I want to be able to change the timeframe of the scanner. Initially, it should be for the 5 minute chart, but I want to be able to choose whatever timeframe.Example:Let's say a stock has an ATR% of 2% in its past n candles (for example, 50 candles)I need to be able to choose the value for n.That means the stock has moved un and down within 2% of its share price for the past 50 candles.Then, the stock has a breakout, and the past x candles (for example, 10 candles) have an ATR% of 6%.That’s a 3 time multiple of their previous ATR%.That means the stock is now in a phase where it moved within 6% of its share price for the past 10 candles.I want to filter any stocks that move in a multiple higher than Z times their previous ATR%. I want to be able to choose the value for Z.That’s for the calculation. There’s also more that I want to include:I also want to be able to set the minimum $ volume traded in the past y candles (for example, minimum 10 million USD volume in the past 10 candles)To do the $ volume we’ll do share volume x s

text:
Hi, I’m Tobias Reyne, a full stack developer with 7 years of experience building JavaScript and TypeScript products with React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and REST APIs.

I’ve built a white-label booking platform for fitness studios in Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, Prisma, and Stripe, where each studio had its own subdomain, timetable, and memberships. It onboarded 64 studios in 6 months. I also built embedded customer analytics dashboards in React, TypeScript, Recharts, Node.js, and PostgreSQL, rolled out to 140 customer accounts.

Your momentum scanner is a strong fit for my background in data-driven UI and backend logic. I can help design the ATR%-based calculations, configurable timeframes and candle windows, breakout multiple filters, and minimum dollar-volume screening in a clean, flexible way.
